type:
Adverb
Pronunciation: /ob-vee-us-lee/
Definition: In a way that is easily seen or understood.
Grammar: Used to emphasize something clear or true.
Usage: Formal/Informal
Synonyms: clearly, evidently, plainly
Examples:
• He was obviously tired.
• That is obviously the best choice.

type:
Noun
Pronunciation: /im-i-grants/
Definition: People who move to live in a new country.
Grammar: Usually used as a plural noun.
Usage: Formal/Informal
Synonyms: newcomers, settlers, migrants
Examples:
• The city has many immigrants from different countries.
• Immigrants often learn a new language.
